scope: Read-only comparison after verified owner-assisted return
findings: The v4.9, v4.14 and v4.19 normal kexec_core paths all omit syscore_shutdown; its absence in this profile is not evidence of an accidental missing generic step
The tested relocation assembly matches upstream v4.9 and v4.14 apart from trailing whitespace
The tested CPU restart header already uses the __pa_symbol translation present in v4.14
The tested reset assembly matches upstream instructions; its idmap section also has a writable attribute
The tested machine_kexec adds reviewed CPU gates and the corrected instruction-cache end address relative to v4.9
Original-kernel interface checks do not establish which exception-level branch the failed diagnostic-source jump used
conclusion: No newly established generic restart omission or relocation instruction difference justifies a speculative fix from this comparison. Target boot and the phase after USB teardown remain unproven.
